mapper.sql: SELECT h.id, h.uuid, h.project_id AS projectId, h.stage_id AS stageId, s.description AS stageName, h.created_at AS createdAt, h.created_by AS createdBy FROM project_status_history h LEFT JOIN stage s ON h.stage_id = s.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC
WHERE h.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC
SELECT MAX(s.sort_order) FROM project_status_history h INNER JOIN stage s ON h.stage_id = s.id WHERE h.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_status_history ( uuid, project_id, stage_id, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{projectId}, #{stageId}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy} )
